cases.purpose: On a vgem DRM node with Mesa software GLES a fragment shader renders the CPU canvas: the swap shader gives the exact swapped colours, a second render starts again from the CPU canvas, and the time uniform changes the output (blue channel by time>0.5).
cases.oracle: Expected frames computed in the fixture from the drawn rectangles and the shader formulas (swap: gl_FragColor=canvas.gbr; time: blue channel = time>0.5), compared byte for byte with the saved PPM; docs/gpu.md resize semantics (preserve overlap, new pixels black); vgem primary node with Mesa software GLES.

import sys
data = open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()
w, h = (int(x) for x in sys.argv[2].split("x"))
head = b"P6\n%d %d\n255\n" % (w, h)
ok = data.startswith(head) and data[len(head):].hex() == sys.argv[3]
if not ok:
    print("observed=%s" % (data[len(head):].hex() if data.startswith(head) else "bad-header:" + data[:16].hex()))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
files.inner.sh:
exec 2>&1
card=
for c in /sys/class/drm/card?; do [[ -e $c ]] || continue; d=$(/usr/bin/readlink -f "$c/device"); [[ ${d##*/} == vgem ]] && card=/dev/dri/${c##*/}; done
[[ -n $card ]] || { echo "setup-failed: no vgem primary node"; exit 1; }
chk() { /usr/bin/python3 -I chk.py "$1" "$2" "$3" && echo "$4=yes" || echo "$4=NO"; }
draw() { gpu rect 0 0 4 2 FF0000; gpu rect 0 2 4 2 00FF00; }
gpu start 4 4 --headless --device $card; echo "start=$?"
draw; echo "draw=$?"
gpu shader "$PWD/swap.frag"; echo "shader-load=$?"
gpu render 0.25; echo "render=$?"; gpu save "$PWD/a.ppm"; echo "save=$?"; chk a.ppm 4x4 0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ffff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000 swapped-pixels-match
gpu render 0.5; echo "render-again=$?"; gpu save "$PWD/b.ppm"; chk b.ppm 4x4 0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ffff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000 second-render-uses-cpu-canvas-again
gpu shader "$PWD/time.frag"; echo "shader-time-load=$?"
gpu render 0.25; echo "render-time-low=$?"; gpu save "$PWD/c.ppm"; chk c.ppm 4x4 ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff000000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff0000ff00 time-low-pixels-match
gpu render 0.75; echo "render-time-high=$?"; gpu save "$PWD/d.ppm"; chk d.ppm 4x4 ff00ffff00ffff00ffff00ffff00ffff00ffff00ffff00ff00ffff00ffff00ffff00ffff00ffff00ffff00ffff00ffff time-high-pixels-match
gpu stop; echo "stop=$?"

cases.purpose: With --transport dmabuf on a vgem node the candidate hands each frame to the Kitty/Kilix frame socket as a 40-byte v2 record (magic, version 2, 4x4, stride, offset, XRGB, modifier, transform 6) plus the buffer descriptor over SCM_RIGHTS; the mapped pixels equal the drawn frame (bottom-up), both frames are acknowledged, info reports transport=dmabuf frames=2 fallbacks=0, and the session directory is removed on stop.
cases.oracle: Model Kitty/Kilix peer (pty query replies, frame-socket accept, SCM_RIGHTS receive and mmap) with expected rows computed from the drawn rectangles and the bottom-left framebuffer origin documented in the wire record.
cases.comparison: Candidate output, status and files compared with values derived independently of candidate output.

files.peer.py:
import base64, mmap, os, re, select, socket, struct, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
bash = sys.argv[1]; card = sys.argv[2]
master, slave = os.openpty(); tty = os.ttyname(slave)
home = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="kilix-", dir=os.getcwd())
script = ("gpu start 4 4 --transport dmabuf --tty %s --device %s; echo \"start=$?\"\n"
          "gpu rect 0 0 4 2 FF0000; gpu rect 0 2 4 2 0000FF; gpu rect 0 0 1 1 00FF00\n"
          "gpu present; echo \"present=$?\"\ngpu info\n"
          "gpu rect 0 0 4 4 FFFFFF; gpu present; echo \"present2=$?\"\ngpu info\n"
          "gpu stop; echo \"stop=$?\"\n") % (tty, card)
proc = subprocess.Popen([bash, "--noprofile", "--norc", "-c", script], stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=dict(os.environ, KILIX_SESSION_HOME=home))
cand, frames, events, buffer = [], [], [], b""
deadline = time.monotonic() + 20
def rows_of(words, view):
    _, _, width, height, stride, offset = words[:6]
    return [view[offset + y * stride: offset + y * stride + width * 4] for y in range(height)]
def pix(row):  # XRGB little-endian: B G R X per pixel, X ignored
    return [ "%02x%02x%02x" % (row[i + 2], row[i + 1], row[i]) for i in range(0, len(row), 4)]
def frame(path):
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_SEQPACKET); s.settimeout(2); s.connect(path)
    data, fds, _, _ = socket.recv_fds(s, 64, 1)
    words = struct.unpack("=10I", data) if len(data) == 40 else ()
    info = {"words": words, "fds": len(fds), "rows": None}
    if fds and words:
        size = os.lseek(fds[0], 0, os.SEEK_END)
        with mmap.mmap(fds[0], size, prot=mmap.PROT_READ) as view:
            info["rows"] = [pix(r) for r in rows_of(words, view)]
        os.close(fds[0])
    s.send(b"\x01"); s.close()
    return info
while time.monotonic() < deadline:
    ready, _, _ = select.select([master, proc.stdout], [], [], 0.05)
    if master in ready:
        try: buffer += os.read(master, 65536)
        except OSError: pass
    while True:
        m = re.search(rb"\x1b_G([^;\x1b]*);?([^\x1b]*)\x1b\\", buffer)
        if not m: break
        buffer = buffer[m.end():]
        ctl = dict(i.split(b"=", 1) for i in m.group(1).split(b",") if b"=" in i)
        act, kind = ctl.get(b"a", b""), ctl.get(b"t", b"")
        events.append((act + b"/" + kind).decode())
        if act == b"q":
            os.write(master, b"\x1b_Gi=" + ctl[b"i"] + b";" + (b"OK" if kind == b"d" else b"ENOTSUP:model peer offers no shared memory") + b"\x1b\\")
        elif act == b"g" and kind == b"g":
            try: frames.append(frame(base64.b64decode(m.group(2)).decode()))
            except OSError as e: frames.append({"error": e.strerror})
    if proc.stdout in ready:
        line = proc.stdout.readline()
        if line: cand.append(line.decode(errors="replace").rstrip())
        elif proc.poll() is not None: break
if proc.poll() is None: proc.kill()
proc.wait()
infos = [l for l in cand if l.startswith("active=")]
def field(l, k):
    mm = re.search(r"\b%s=(\S+)" % k, l); return mm.group(1) if mm else "?"
for l in cand:
    if l.startswith(("start=", "present=", "present2=", "stop=")): print(l)
    if l.startswith("active="):
        print("info transport=%s frames=%s fallbacks=%s" % (field(l, "transport"), field(l, "frames"), field(l, "fallbacks")))
R, G, B = "ff0000", "00ff00", "0000ff"
expect = [[[B]*4, [B]*4, [R]*4, [G, R, R, R]], [["ffffff"]*4]*4]
print("frames-received=%d" % len(frames))
for n, f in enumerate(frames, 1):
    if "error" in f: print("frame%d error=%s" % (n, f["error"])); continue
    w = f["words"]
    magic = "%#x" % w[0] if w else "?"
    fourcc = struct.pack("=I", w[6]).decode(errors="replace") if w else "?"
    print("frame%d magic=%s version=%d size=%dx%d fourcc=%s transform=%d fds=%d stride-ok=%s offset=%d modifier-words=%d pixels-match=%s" % (
        n, magic, w[1], w[2], w[3], fourcc, w[9], f["fds"], "yes" if w[4] >= 16 and w[4] % 4 == 0 else "NO", w[5], 2,
        "yes" if f["rows"] == expect[n - 1] else "NO %s" % f["rows"]))
print("graphics-packets-with-frame-socket-handoff=%d" % events.count("g/g"))
print("session-dir-left=%s" % os.listdir(home))
print("candidate-exit=%s" % proc.returncode)
os.rmdir(home)
